With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Emberhold's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.

Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 34 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 62) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 42, fan favor 22 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 62) ◈ the Witness — 7 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 43) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open.
